cohort: Pregnant patients who delivered at a medical college hospital in Karnataka, India, between January 2014 and April 2020, excluding those who delivered before 24 weeks gestation, underwent hysterectomy for non-obstetric reasons, or had the procedure after 42 days postpartum.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomy (EPH) was 0.056%, and the most common indication was atonic postpartum hemorrhage.
